reason: Both conversations reached the correct conclusion that the king-size duvet was blocking the latch and that no part was needed, with no safety issues. Conversation 2 correctly and confidently identified dE as a door error from the outset, flagged overloading pushing on the door in its first turn, asked for the model number, and finished with genuinely useful UK-homeowner advice tailored to the 'mum's duvet, visitors coming' situation (cover-only wash, airing, launderette). Conversation 1 was honest but needlessly hedged on the meaning of dE, never directly asked what was in the drum (the customer volunteered it), and leaned toward engineer/interlock talk early. Conversation 2 is marked down for padding its first reply with premature door-lock/control-board part speculation and US-centric pricing and terminology ('$20-$60', 'breaker', 'laundromat'), which keeps the margin slight.
